published_baseline: Founder-approved permanent three-domain Global Risk recovery. /global-risk always presents Geopolitical, Macroeconomic and Critical Minerals risk as three fixed verified domain indices in addition to the combined GRI. Each domain retains its own last verified reading until a newer verified reading for that domain arrives; newer verified results replace only that domain. The canonical assembler scans verified same-methodology history per domain and carries the domain's own reading snapshot/timestamp/status. No domain may disappear merely because the newest combined snapshot lacks a fresh reading for it. No synthetic score, zero fallback, interpolation, payment weakening or source-rights bypass is allowed. Intelligence, Ask and Risk Indices remain separate serving failure domains.
policy: Public website presentation is frozen. Intentional website changes require explicit founder approval and a dedicated baseline update.
